claim: A cold boot into normal Omarchy loads the Oriole Wi-Fi stack and provides a usable network path to an Agent.
oracle: After a cold boot, the phone reaches the graphical session, a wireless interface is present, the user can select an authorized network without a stored credential in the image, DHCP installs a route, DNS resolves, HTTPS reaches the endpoint, and a controlled link recovery repeats the check.

user_journey.scenario: The user starts an Agent from the Omarchy desktop, the Wi-Fi link drops once, and the Agent resumes after reconnect; if the driver or firmware is absent, the desktop reports a clear network-unavailable state and keeps USB recovery available.
user_journey.expected: The user sees a connected network and can run the Agent API request, or sees an actionable failure without losing the Android A recovery path.

invariants: The normal boot service never stores or prints SSIDs, MAC addresses, passwords or modem data.
The service is fail-closed when the exact Oriole modules or user-supplied firmware are absent.
USB serial recovery is created before any handoff to systemd and remains available when Wi-Fi startup fails.
No modem, calibration, persist, efs, vbmeta or slot-A path is touched.
gitnexus: The public Oriole tree is an evidence snapshot; the normal desktop integration boundary is the device package install tree and systemd/network manager handoff.
The private handoff script must create oriole-bringup-serial.service before /run/oriole-stage-continue.
ast: The smoke runner has no mutation path by default; its optional inputs are endpoint and URL only.
The package install script stages the runner without enabling a radio service.

unit.red: The package previously had no normal-boot network acceptance command and the install script relied on GNU-only install -D behavior.
unit.green: The portable package staging path and read-only smoke runner parse and package successfully.
cases: successful smoke path with sanitized output

boundaries: cold boot -> systemd handoff -> device package -> kernel modules/firmware -> NetworkManager -> DHCP/DNS/HTTPS
USB serial recovery remains available if the network path fails
faults: desktop handoff before serial service creation
evidence: Diagnostic W3 association evidence proves the radio path only; this plan remains open until a cold normal desktop run is captured.

limitations: The public repository does not contain proprietary Broadcom firmware or user credentials.
The current phone session has USB serial but no usb0/SSH, so the cold desktop gate has not run in this turn.
Cellular data and camera are separate gates and are not upgraded by Wi-Fi evidence.
exit_gate: Create the serial service before handoff, boot the same verified kernel into normal Omarchy, run omamobile-network-smoke, capture DHCP/DNS/HTTPS and one reconnect, then re-run the user journey.
